# Recorded execution evidence

The event tests reuse existing repository fixtures without invented prices or timestamps:

- `tests/fixtures/dollar_bar_crash_reversal_15m.parquet`: actual irregular bar opens and their recorded timestamps, used as observable price points.
- `tests/fixtures/spot_15m_20250101_20250531.parquet`: recorded regular Binance BTCUSDT OHLC with declared 900-second intervals.
- `tests/fixtures/binance_trades_btcusdt_2025-05-23_90s.zip`: recorded Binance BTCUSDT trades; source timestamps are microseconds, converted exactly to UTC nanoseconds. At duplicate timestamps the last recorded trade provides the price.

These fixtures predate this change. Numerical targets, costs and scenario funding rates in tests are explicit strategy/economic assumptions, not claimed market observations. Year-long funding calibration remains private pending redistribution rights; no replacement market data is fabricated.
